description_fill_in: Unique alphanumeric session identifier assigned to each support interaction. Essential for maintaining conversation memory state and contextual multi-turn tracking in Redis/in-memory buffer.
Sequential turn index (1 to 10) denoting the dialogue exchange number within an ongoing session. Used to detect multi-turn loop stalemates and user frustration.
Classified primary customer intent / topic category (e.g., billing, technical, product_info, complaint, shipping, returns, account) used for intent-based routing and domain RAG document filtering.
Natural Language Understanding (NLU) / classification confidence metric. Scores below threshold (e.g. < 0.68) trigger confirmation prompts or automatic human escalation.
Binary indicator where 1 denotes the conversation turn triggered a handoff/escalation to a human tier-2 support agent, and 0 denotes automated resolution by the chatbot.
Post-interaction Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score rating ranging from 1 (Very Dissatisfied) to 5 (Very Satisfied), serving as the core business success metric.
System response latency measured in milliseconds from user query ingestion to final LLM output generation (including retrieval latency and token streaming).
